description: Reads explicitly saved supplier settings for one visible store. This is settings data, not supplier availability or listing usage data. It must never be interpreted as an enabled, disabled or suspended supplier state. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

name: hgr_get_source_configuration
title: Get Source Configuration
